release_notes_body:
## React 19

### Breaking Changes

- BREAKING CHANGE: `ReactDOM.render` is removed. Use `createRoot` from `react-dom/client` instead.
- BREAKING CHANGE: `ReactDOM.hydrate` is removed. Use `hydrateRoot` from `react-dom/client` instead.
- BREAKING CHANGE: Legacy string refs are removed. Migrate to callback refs or `useRef`.
- BREAKING CHANGE: `defaultProps` on function components is removed. Use ES6 default parameters instead.
- BREAKING CHANGE: `act` is no longer exported from `react-dom/test-utils`. Import it from `react` directly.
- BREAKING CHANGE: `React.createFactory` is removed. Use JSX directly.
- BREAKING CHANGE: `react-test-renderer` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use `@testing-library/react` instead.

### New Features

- Actions: Functions using async transitions.
- `use` API: Read resources in render.
- React Server Components are now stable.
- Document Metadata: Render `<title>` and `<meta>` anywhere in the tree.

## React 18.3

### Deprecations (preparation for React 19)

- Deprecated: `ReactDOM.render` — will be removed in React 19. Use `createRoot` instead.
- Deprecated: `ReactDOM.hydrate` — will be removed in React 19. Use `hydrateRoot` instead.
- Deprecated: `act` export from `react-dom/test-utils` — import from `react` instead.
- Deprecated: string refs — migrate to callback refs.
- Deprecated: `defaultProps` on function components.
- Deprecated: `React.createFactory`.

Migrate away from these APIs now to avoid errors when upgrading to React 19.
